name: get_current_weather
description: Get the current weather for a place.

location.description: The city and optionally the country, e.g. "London" or "Paris, France". Leave it empty for where the user is (guessed from their IP address).

name: list_directory
description: List the files and directories in a directory of the user's home directory (directories end with /). Hidden files are never shown.

path.description: The directory, e.g. "~" or "~/Documents"; relative paths are relative to the home directory.

name: read_file
description: Read a text file in the user's home directory (at most the first 64 KB). Hidden files cannot be read.

path.description: The file, e.g. "~/Documents/notes.txt"; relative paths are relative to the home directory.

name: list_todos
description: Show the user's todo list, numbered. Call it when the user asks what is on it, or before removing an item you are not sure of.

name: add_todo
description: Add an item to the user's todo list. Call it whenever the user asks you to remember, note, put on the list or add something to do; it is only added if you call this.

item.description: The item, short, in the user's words, e.g. "buy milk".

name: remove_todo
description: Remove an item from the user's todo list, when it is done or the user asks you to; it is only removed if you call this.

item.description: The item's number from list_todos, or (part of) its text.
